newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon exports up 27.6 pct in 1996 - Banque Audi.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon exports up 27.6 pct in 1996 - Banque Audi.

text.p: Lebanon's combined industrial and agricultural exports rose 27.6 percent in 1996 to $1.019 billion from $824 million in 1995, Banque Audi said in its latest economic report issued on Monday.
Industrial exports rose 23.7 percent, the bank said in its report for the final quarter of 1995.

"1996 was marked by a rebound of foreign demand for Lebanese products, shown in the 23.7 percent increase in (industrial) exports at a time when the Lebanese pound appreciated by 2.8 percent," the report said.

"This is evidence of recovered price competitiveness which could promote the industrial sector which is still marked by the atomisation of units of production, a fragile financial situation and a poor ability to innovate.
"The consolidation of this price competitiveness can only come about if salaries are indexed to productivity," Banque Audi said.
It cited statistics of the General Directorate of Industry as saying 459 new industrial enterprises employing 3,414 people were founded in 1996 compared with 431 in 1995.
